verdict.rationale: dlt ships an official MCP server (dlt-hub/dlt-mcp) with a documented server-card exposing tools for querying, inspecting, debugging, and managing dlt pipelines/schemas/secrets, and the dltHub AI Harness explicitly provides MCP servers to connect coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.
